evidence_scope: Shared 2000-session diagnostic candidate membership only; not private validation and not served HR@10.

prior_experiment_boundary.classification: implementation failure before target-free stages, not an algorithm No-Go
prior_experiment_boundary.formal_read_denied: No v2.21 claim, outer, terminal, runtime, trace, cache, or result may be read by v2.22 formal code.

hypothesis.claim: Targets absent from complete variable-C200 are more likely hidden by representation/field mismatch than by insufficient depth. Four independently fielded sparse views over only visible active state can recover orthogonal candidates without changing the served prefix.
distinct_from_v2_21: v2.21 had only category-only and current positive material/style/use_case routes
v2.22 adds accumulated exact-active, full-positive, and title/store field-isolated views
v2.22 current-positive covers every supported positive slot, not only three core slots
v2.22 freezes corrected runtime cleanup identity semantics

proxy.access: evaluator-side only after the frozen pre_target_attach_gate passes in full; no earlier stat, open, hash, or read

label_archive.member_access_policy: The evaluator loader requests exactly these three named numeric members in this order and rejects every other requested member. It never enumerates, deserializes, or reads any other archive member.
label_archive.access: evaluator-side only after the frozen pre_target_attach_gate passes in full; no earlier stat, open, hash, or read

allowed: catalog metadata and SQLite FTS index

normalization.base: Existing deterministic NFKC/casefold/separator/unit aliases from starter.attributes.normalize_value.
normalization.surface_expansion: Only existing CATEGORIES and SLOT_VOCABULARIES registry aliases; no outcome-derived synonym or new hand-written target rule.
normalization.exact_active_terms: Use only ConversationConstraintView.exact_terms: normalize each visible active_terms element independently, require _is_meaningful_exact, and exclude it when all normalized tokens were consumed by the frozen vocabulary matcher. Excluded terms never enter a positive route.

frozen_extractor_closure.rule: Formal execution imports these functions only from source bytes whose Git blob equals the listed parent blob; worktree shadow modules and alternate extractors are denied.

constraint_and_mask_semantics.ledger_filter: A record is visible only when status is exactly starter.slot_ledger.ACTIVE and version equals the positive integer current_version. polarity must be -1 or +1; hardness must be hard or soft. Retrieval surfaces use current-version positive records from supported_positive_slots regardless of hard/soft. Conflict masks execute hard records only.
constraint_and_mask_semantics.negative_execution: Execute only a current-version ACTIVE hard polarity=-1 record in allowed_negative_slots whose registry-canonical value is one ASCII [a-z0-9]+ token and is also present as the same (slot,value) in ConversationConstraintView.negative. All other negative records are ignored, never broadened.
constraint_and_mask_semantics.positive_execution: Execute only current-version ACTIVE hard polarity=+1 records in supported_positive_slots with a registry-canonical value. Category positives also include canonical category values from category_text.

catalog_evidence.details_prefix_grammar: For a mapping-valued product.details, sort keys by normalize_value(key), map a normalized key to the first matching slot in this fixed precedence: audience if it contains department/gender/audience; material if material/fabric; color if color; closure if closure; width if width; size if size; style if style/pattern/fit; brand if brand/manufacturer; otherwise ignore. The source string is exactly 'details.' + (normalize_value(key) or 'value'). Flatten nested mapping values by normalized-key order and lists/tuples in input order. Only frozen vocabulary canonical values are emitted for non-brand slots.
catalog_evidence.general_field_extraction: categories, title, and features are flattened by the frozen attributes._flatten order. Category values come from categories/title; every SLOT_VOCABULARIES slot is extracted by frozen longest-surface then lexical matching. Non-mapping details additionally uses the same general vocabulary extraction. store produces brand only and never supplies a positive-conflict slot.
catalog_evidence.unknown_metadata_policy: keep candidate; a positive conflict exists only when at least one reliable canonical value is known for that slot and the known set is disjoint from the requested set
catalog_evidence.negative_policy: drop only when starter.p8_negative.classify_candidate returns explicit_violation

constraint_and_mask_semantics.budget_and_price: Price/budget are neither queried as structured positive slots nor hard-masked in v2.22. No budget relaxation, price filter, or price-derived admission rule exists.
constraint_and_mask_semantics.mask_rank_semantics: Each route is ranked by frozen FTS first; its returned identifiers then receive hard-conflict decisions. Dropped identifiers leave holes and are not replaced by queries deeper than LIMIT 120. RRF ranks use each surviving candidate's original one-based pre-mask route rank.

retrieval_routes.fts_schema: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE products USING fts5(parent_asin UNINDEXED, title, categories, features, details, store, description, tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')
retrieval_routes.fts_sql_exact: SELECT rowid,parent_asin FROM products WHERE products MATCH ? ORDER BY bm25(products,0.0,6.0,4.0,2.5,2.5,1.5,1.0),parent_asin ASC LIMIT 120
retrieval_routes.fts_rank_order: weighted SQLite bm25 ascending, then parent_asin lexical ascending; rowid is returned for integrity only and is not a tie-break
retrieval_routes.term_quoting: Each normalized term is an FTS phrase: one double quote on each side and every embedded double quote doubled. A route expression is {field1 field2 ...} : (quoted_term OR quoted_term ...), with fields and terms in their frozen orders.
retrieval_routes.activation_definition: A route is activated for a turn iff its frozen source set yields at least one normalized term after lexical sort and the first-24 cap, which makes its FTS expression non-empty. Activation is counted before cache lookup and is independent of whether SQLite returns a row.
retrieval_routes.surface_and_cap_order: For each slot/value, take the canonical normalized value plus every normalized registry surface mapping to it; union all route sources, remove empty values and duplicates, sort lexically, then retain the first 24 terms. Fields retain the order declared below.

full_positive.terms: union of canonical category surfaces, every current-version positive supported-slot surface, and exact_active_terms

title_store_exact.terms: exact_active_terms only, allowing catalog store to act as the available brand field

fusion_and_safety.score: exact Fraction sum over 1/(60+rank) for every activated route containing the candidate
fusion_and_safety.hard_mask: Before fusion admission, reject current-version executable negative conflicts and explicit positive slot conflicts using catalog-known values only.

cache.semantic_equivalence: cache-disabled direct, cache-enabled direct, and cache-enabled literal module must be byte/semantic identical

runtime_cleanup_contract.root_identity: Bind lexical parent, no-reparse ancestry, directory type, st_dev and st_ino/file-index. Do not compare directory mtime or size after owned child creation.
runtime_cleanup_contract.refresh: If a platform lacks stable inode/file-index, refresh an explicit post-construction identity before child execution and verify only stable identity fields during cleanup.
owned_children_allowlist: trace files declared by the launch
runtime_cleanup_contract.recursive_delete: Allowed only for the fresh nonce-scoped runtime after parent/identity/reparse/content checks; never delete runtime base or another experiment directory.
runtime_cleanup_contract.synthetic_regression: A create-child-write-close-cleanup lifecycle test must pass in direct and literal-module modes before any formal claim.

required: runner and worker direct/module import evaluator.local_evaluator
at limit=100 each of full_positive, exact_active, category_only, and title_store_exact has aggregate activation>0
at limit=100 union expansion records>0 and union novel candidate cells>0
at limit=100 each cache-enabled direct/module worker records hits>0 separately for fts_route, product_view, and mask_decision
zero duplicate, loss, reorder, explicit hard-conflict, legacy route execution
cached direct+module parent wall <=60 seconds at limit=100
every key named in resource_gates.preflight_applicable_gates passes
target_free_preflight.no_information_result: If any of the four route activation counts, union expansion records, union novel candidate cells, or three cache-layer hit counts is zero at limit=100, emit PRE_OUTCOME_NO_INFORMATION, do not create the candidate claim, and do not open proxy or labels.

receipt_fields_required: union expansion record and novel-candidate-cell counts
route, mask, extra-total, and complete-turn P95
source, input, trace, semantic, and receipt hashes
resource_gates.timing_definitions: Use time.perf_counter_ns around each uncached SQLite route execution, the complete per-turn hard-mask phase, all v2.22 extra route+mask work, and the complete worker turn. Convert to milliseconds only after collecting integer nanoseconds; nearest-rank P95 is the sorted value at ceil(0.95*N)-1. Wall is unrounded perf_counter elapsed. Throughput is completed trace records divided by worker wall seconds. Peak RSS is the Windows process PeakWorkingSet64 sampled by the parent after process close, with worker psutil/resource self-report used only as a consistency lower bound.
resource_gates.ratio_definitions: candidate-cell ratio is math.fsum of complete expanded candidate lengths over sealed candidate_cells=2425785. Trace-byte ratio is each canonical expanded JSONL byte length over sealed reference bytes=32226135. Both full replicas must independently pass.

candidate_recall_receipt.pre_target_attach_gate: Before the first proxy or label stat/open/hash/read: both full workers must exit zero; both partial traces must be fsynced, exclusively published, closed, and canonical; both in-process worker receipts must be fully captured and closed; trace bytes and semantic digests must exactly repeat; all executable source blobs plus catalog, visible_context, and both sealed-C200 identities/hashes must match; every record must preserve the complete ordered C200 prefix; loss, duplicate, reorder, explicit-hard-conflict, legacy-route, schema, and privacy violations must all equal zero; and every key named in resource_gates.candidate_pre_target_gates must pass independently for both workers and the parent. The experiment-level outer capture is deliberately not a pre-target condition because the outer PowerShell writes it only after the runner exits. Any pre-target failure becomes implementation INVALID without target attach.
candidate_recall_receipt.target_source_open_sequence: After and only after pre_target_attach_gate passes, enter a one-way target-attach phase: stat/open/read raw proxy bytes, verify exact bytes/rows/SHA-256 before parsing only the target and frozen eligibility fields; then stat/open/read raw label archive bytes, verify exact bytes/SHA-256 before requesting exactly outer_fold, family_index, taxonomy_code in order. A proxy/label identity or parse failure is INVALID_AFTER_TARGET_ATTACH, consumes v2.22, and is never retried.
candidate_recall_receipt.expanded_fixed_k200_semantics: EXPANDED_FIXED_K200 includes the newly fused v2.22 tail whenever the sealed variable prefix has fewer than 200 candidates. It is candidate output, must be reported, has no frozen baseline count, and may legitimately exceed 1986.
candidate_recall_receipt.exact_target_cluster_uniform_formula: After both traces close and all pre-target gates pass, group the 2000 evaluator-side session membership values by exact proxy ground-truth parent_asin (family_index is audit-only, not the grouping key) without emitting identifiers. For each exact target cluster compute the arithmetic mean session recall separately for SEALED_VARIABLE_C200 and C400_COMPLETE_UNION; then take the unweighted arithmetic mean across all unique exact target clusters. Report baseline, candidate, and candidate-minus-baseline; the frozen promotion test is candidate-minus-baseline > 0.
candidate_recall_receipt.non_clothing_definition: taxonomy_code in {0,2,3}; incremental sessions with taxonomy_code=1 are clothing and do not satisfy this gate

promotion_metric_formulas.membership_unit: one of the fixed 2000 sessions; for a view V, membership[s,V] is true iff the session target occurs in V at any evaluator-eligible turn under the frozen intent-override eligibility boundary
promotion_metric_formulas.c400_count: sum over all 2000 sessions of int(membership[s,C400_COMPLETE_UNION])
promotion_metric_formulas.new_targets: despite the historical field name, this is the number of incremental sessions, not unique identifiers: sum int(C400 membership and not SEALED_VARIABLE_C200 membership)
promotion_metric_formulas.outer_fold_span: cardinality of the set of outer_fold codes among only incremental sessions
promotion_metric_formulas.non_clothing_count: number of incremental sessions whose taxonomy_code is 0, 2, or 3
promotion_metric_formulas.candidate_loss: count of turn-level sealed-prefix identifiers missing, duplicated, or reordered in expanded output; frozen gate is exactly 0
promotion_metric_formulas.hard_conflict: count of admitted novel tail candidate cells for which either executable-negative explicit_violation or reliable-positive conflict is true; frozen gate is separately exactly 0
promotion_metric_formulas.combined_field_forbidden: candidate_loss and hard_conflict must be reported and gated separately; they may not be collapsed into a net or combined count

candidate_recall_receipt.valid_no_go: Only after every pre-target and post-target source/schema/privacy/integrity/resource/exact-repeat gate passes: C400<=1987, fewer than two incremental sessions, fold span<2, non-clothing increment<1, or exact-target-cluster-uniform delta<=0 is a valid algorithm No-Go. Freeze exact v2.22 and move to the next independent mechanism; never tune routes or depth.
candidate_recall_receipt.invalid_one_shot: Any source, schema, privacy, integrity, exact-repeat, worker-exit, publication, resource, proxy/label identity, or post-target final-gate failure is INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED, never an algorithm No-Go, and v2.22 is never retried.
candidate_recall_receipt.go: Only permits a new preregistered 100-session served-policy smoke; it is not Top10 improvement.

device_selection.reason: SQLite FTS5, normalization, branch-heavy masks, exact Fraction RRF, dedupe and stable append are sparse CPU operations without a frozen equivalent GPU backend.
device_selection.cpu_gpu_benchmark_not_applicable_reason: The mechanism is SQLite FTS5 plus branch-heavy Python masking/RRF; inventing a CUDA retrieval backend would change the algorithm rather than benchmark an equivalent backend.
device_selection.future_dense_policy: For a later dense/encoding mechanism, benchmark the same 100-1000 target-free queries on CPU and an idle local GPU. Select GPU only with no install/download or process preemption, <=11GB VRAM, no OOM/NaN, identical candidate set/order/hash and exact repeat, and >=1.5x wall speedup.

protected_data_and_git.formal_git_environment: Clear every inherited environment variable whose name starts with GIT_ before launching pinned Git. Set only explicit cwd and deterministic locale variables required by the harness.

formal_git_isolation.config_and_replace_policy: The repository-local config and three worktree control files must match the pinned raw identities before and after every Git cell and contain no include/includeIf section. No system/global/includes/replace refs, hooks, attributes, aliases, pager, optional locks, or environment-supplied object directory/index/worktree are honored.

protected_data_and_git.runtime_source_origin: The source-only bootstrap materializes/loads exactly the parent manifest plus the candidate-commit blobs for the six v2.22 implementation paths. Every local module __file__, loader origin, raw Git blob and import allowlist is checked; project cwd/sys.path discovery, dirty bytes, pyc, namespace packages, shadow modules and every other local import are denied.
protected_data_and_git.destructive_history_and_artifact_actions: No force/force-push, rebase, reset --hard, amend, branch or tag deletion, old artifact deletion, claim deletion, or artifact overwrite/replacement.
protected_data_and_git.irreversible_candidate_lock: Before the first stat/open/hash/read of catalog, visible_context, either sealed C200 replica, proxy, or label archive, the formal harness binds one pushed candidate commit SHA, its exact six implementation blobs, the corrected prereg blob, local branch and remote-tracking ref. From that first frozen-input access onward no code/blob/commit change or new follow-up is allowed within v2.22, even before a claim; any required change becomes a new experiment/preregistration. Preclaim synthetic tests are source-only and may not access these frozen inputs.
protected_data_and_git.ordinary_linear_followup_fix_commits_bef: Allowed only while no v2.22 claim exists; prereg must remain ancestor, no merge commit, cumulative prereg-to-candidate changed-path set must remain exact, and every candidate commit must be pushed before source access.

durable_one_shot_protocol.preclaim_harness: Before every fixed claim, source-only PS checks Git and four entrypoint cells, then independently checks checkpoint/worktree again. Candidate additionally binds and independently rechecks the exact preflight claim/outer/terminal chain.
durable_one_shot_protocol.transaction: O_EXCL/create-new claim and fsync before process; after process closes, O_EXCL/fsync exact raw outer before parsing; O_EXCL/fsync one COMPLETE or INVALID terminal. Never truncate, unlink, overwrite, replace, or rerun after claim.
durable_one_shot_protocol.invalid: Any failure after claim is implementation INVALID, not algorithm No-Go, and v2.22 is never rerun.

formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.full_workers: Exactly two, strictly sequential with no overlap: fresh cached direct first, then only after its process exits and trace/receipt closes, fresh cached literal-module second.
formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.worker_parent_wall: For each worker, unrounded perf_counter elapsed from immediately before subprocess creation through process exit, stdout/stderr capture closure, worker receipt parse, and exclusive trace publication verification. Later nonce-runtime deletion is excluded from the worker clock.
formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.pre_target_parent_wall: One unrounded perf_counter clock begins immediately before direct-worker launch and ends after module-worker exit, both closed-trace validations and exact-repeat, and all source/Git/schema/privacy/candidate_pre_target resource gates, immediately before the first proxy/label stat or open. It excludes target attach, target aggregation, and later runtime cleanup, and is the only parent-wall value used by pre_target_attach_gate.
formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.full_formal_parent_wall: One unrounded perf_counter clock begins immediately before direct-worker launch and ends only after module-worker exit, both trace validations and exact-repeat, pre-target source/Git/resource gates, target attach and aggregate calculation, final source/Git hash checks, and both nonce-runtime cleanups. It includes both sequential worker walls and every operation between them. It excludes the already-durable candidate claim creation, outer PowerShell preclaim checks, bootstrap startup before runner entry, terminal JSON serialization/fsync, and outer process teardown; those exclusions are fixed and reported separately as outer transaction wall.
formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.post_target_rule: After target attach, every key in resource_gates.post_target_final_gates must pass before COMPLETE; failure is implementation INVALID and cannot be used as a promotion result.
formal_worker_schedule_and_clocks.outer_transaction_wall: Measured and reported from immediately before bootstrap process creation through process exit, raw outer O_EXCL/fsync, terminal O_EXCL/fsync, and verified safe runtime cleanup; diagnostic only and not substituted for the full_formal_parent_wall gate.

checkpoint_choreography.preregistration: This JSON only, ordinary commit, direct child of parent_commit, pushed before implementation.
checkpoint_choreography.corrective_prereg_followup: The original JSON-only prereg commit may have one or more ordinary JSON-only linear corrections before any frozen-input access or claim. The last correction commit/blob is the effective prereg checkpoint pinned by the formal harness; it must be pushed before the six-path implementation commit and remain its ancestor. No correction may inspect target-free traces or outcomes.
checkpoint_choreography.frozen_v2_21_source_boundary: The six v2.21 implementation blobs remain byte-for-byte unchanged, are not deleted or renamed, and are not formal runtime dependencies of v2.22. v2.22 may depend only on pre-existing stable baseline modules plus the six new v2.22 paths.

stop_rules.preflight_invalid: Freeze v2.22 as implementation failure, never rerun, choose an independent mechanism.
stop_rules.valid_no_go: Freeze exact routes/depth/fusion and choose an independent mechanism.
stop_rules.valid_go: Create a new branch/worktree and preregister the 100-session served-policy smoke before implementation or outcome.
